components.name: AES-KW (RFC 3394) — A128KW/A192KW/A256KW JOSE key wrapping via spomky-labs/aes-key-wrap
components.bom-ref: pqs:finding:src/Library/Encryption/Algorithm/KeyEncryption/AESKW.php:16,36,39,41,48,51,53,62:AES-KW (RFC 3394) — A128KW/A192KW/A256KW JOSE key wrapping via spomky-labs/aes-key-wrap

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed encrypted private-key fixtures (ES256/384/512, plus a Console sample) using legacy OpenSSL PEM encryption: 3DES-CBC key derivation via the MD5-based DEK-Info path. Test fixtures for the library's KeyConverter legacy PEM decryption support; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AKPKey.php:100 is PROBE_KEY — the RFC 9964 appendix A all-zero-seed ML-DSA-44 PrivateKeyInfo, hardcoded to probe whether the OpenSSL build supports ML-DSA. Public test-vector material, not a live secret. vectors.json entries are the same RFC 9964 public example keys. Changeable here; harmless by design but genuine hardcoded key bytes in source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live library code: KeyConverter::loadKeyFromP12 / legacy PEM decryption derives the symmetric key with bare MD5 (EVP_BytesToKey, no salt, 1 round) to decrypt 'Proc-Type: 4,ENCRYPTED' PEMs. Weak KDF guarding encrypted key files the library loads at runtime.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Same two lines as the MD5 object: password-to-key derivation for legacy PEM decryption is a bare, unsalted, single-round MD5 chain (EVP_BytesToKey). Real password verifier/KDF in shipped library code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Library hash dispatch: 'sha1' entry feeds the experimental HS1 (HMAC-SHA-1) and RS1 (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 with SHA-1) JWS algorithms in src/Experimental/Signature, both returning 'sha1' as their hash. SHA-1 is a reachable hash surface in the shipped library, not a dead table entry.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Fixture covering the 'none' key type / thumbprint path. The library genuinely ships an opt-in unsecured-JWS ('none') algorithm; this test exercises it. Test-only site, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's HMAC-SHA-2 JWS algorithms HS256/HS384/HS512: DI service aliases (signature_hmac.php), signature classes, benchmark and test call sites. Shared-secret MACs — symmetric, not Shor-broken, but the shared secret's confidentiality is the PQ concern; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's RSASSA JWS algorithms: RS256/384/512 (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5) and PS256/384/512 (RSA-PSS) — DI config, algorithm classes, benchmarks and tests. Shor-vulnerable RSA signatures; migration target ML-DSA-65 or SLH-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's RSA-OAEP / RSA-OAEP-256 JWE key-encryption algorithms (RSAOAEP class, encryption_rsa.php DI registration, benchmarks, RFC 7520 tests). Shor-vulnerable RSA public-key encryption of CEKs — harvest-now-decrypt-later applies to captured JWEs; migration target ML-KEM-768.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The Poly1305 tag is the MAC half of the shipped ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD; every site is the chacha20-poly1305 registration surface (AlgorithmCollector registry, EncryptionSource capability check against openssl_get_cipher_methods, DI service config). One logical asset with the ChaCha20-Poly1305 object.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RFC 7520 (JOSE cookbook) vector-reproduction tests deliberately pin the published IVs ($expected_iv) so the produced ciphertext matches the RFC example; the shipped JWE path generates random IVs at runtime. Static IVs exist only in test code, by design; test-only, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's secp256k1 (P-256K) EC support: curve-creation dispatch, key-size map, curve↔OID map and OpenSSL curve-name map in ECKey.php, the ES256K key analyzer, and ES256K signature tests. Backs the ES256K JWS algorithm — Shor-vulnerable ECDSA over the Koblitz curve; migration target ML-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JOSE A128CBC-HS256 / A192CBC-HS384 / A256CBC-HS512 content-encryption algorithms (RFC 7516) implemented over OpenSSL aes-*-cbc, plus two AES-256-CBC legacy-PEM key fixtures. Unauthenticated CBC with separate HMAC; shipped library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Experimental A128CTR/A192CTR/A256CTR key-encryption algorithm classes returning aes-*-ctr OpenSSL cipher methods; shipped experimental CTR-mode support in src/Experimental/KeyEncryption.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two committed copies of the same legacy-PEM-encrypted (AES-256-CBC, Proc-Type: 4,ENCRYPTED) RSA private-key fixture used by Bundle and KeyManagement tests. Test-only key material, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSAKey.php builds RSAPrivateKey ASN.1 structures when converting loaded PEM keys to JWK form in the KeyConverter path; classical RSA (Shor-vulnerable) key handling in shipped library code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: generate.sh creates a self-signed test CA (openssl req -x509, CN=cose-lib test CA, 36500-day validity) for the RFC 9964 openssl-cli fixtures. Test PKI infrastructure only, not production trust material; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSAKeysTest loads the committed RSASSA-PSS PKCS#8 fixture through JWKFactory, exercising the library's PS256/PS384/PS512 (RSA-PSS) signature support. RSA-PSS is Shor-vulnerable; test site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed low-public-exponent RSA key fixture used to exercise the KeyAnalyzer's weak-key warnings; genuine weak RSA key material in the repo, test-only, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed PKCS#8 RSASSA-PSS private-key fixture for KeyManagement tests; content-identified key material, Shor-vulnerable RSA, test-only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's ECDH-ES JWE key-agreement algorithms (ECDH-ES+A128KW/A192KW/A256KW, ECDH-ES+AxGCM) over P-256/P-384/P-521/X25519, with Concat/X9.63 KDF derivation. Shor-vulnerable elliptic-curve key agreement — harvest-now-decrypt-later on captured JWEs; migration target ML-KEM-768.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's Ed25519 (EdDSA) signature support: capability-checked DI registration (Ed25519::isSupported()), signature_eddsa.php service config, benchmark key material ('crv'=>'Ed25519'). Shor-vulnerable signature; migration target ML-DSA-65 / SLH-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's ECDSA JWS algorithms ES256/ES384/ES512 over NIST P-256/P-384/P-521: benchmarks, DI config, algorithm classes. Shor-vulnerable signatures; migration target ML-DSA-65 / SLH-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 key-agreement curve support inside the library's ECDH-ES algorithms: benchmark JWKs ('crv'=>'X25519'), OKP key handling and curve registries. Shor-vulnerable DH agreement; migration target ML-KEM-768.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA core and its curve variants: the ECDSA base class DI registration plus experimental Brainpool signatures BP256R1/BP384R1/BP512R1 extending it, and the ext-openssl dependency note. Shor-vulnerable ECDSA family (NIST + Brainpool curves); migration target ML-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The JOSE 'EdDSA' umbrella algorithm (Ed25519/Ed448 curves): alias registration, benchmarks, AlgorithmAnalyzer's EdDSA branch and OKPKeyAnalyzer curve mapping. Same family as the Ed25519 (ALG-5e08bdf5) and Ed448 (ALG-fd76e253) objects; Shor-vulnerable signatures, migration ML-DSA-65 / SLH-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Positive posture control: every secret-dependent comparison in the library (HMAC verify, AES-CBC-HS tag, RSA PKCS1/OAEP padding lHash, Blake2b MAC, ML-DSA seed check, JWK thumbprint) goes through hash_equals. This is the constant-time-comparison half of the picture and directly supports rejecting ALG-99c6681d.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256 (secp256r1/prime256v1) curve support: ECKey's OpenSSL curve-name map, prime256v1 certificate PEM/DER test fixtures loaded through JWKFactory/fromCertificateFile, and fixture generation. Shor-vulnerable curve (ECDSA/ECDH); migration target ML-DSA / ML-KEM.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed SEC1 EC private-key fixtures (ES256/ES384/ES512 keys; the same files whose legacy-PEM encryption uses 3DES, inventoried separately). Content-identified key material; Shor-vulnerable EC keys; test-only, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed PKCS#8 Ed25519 private-key fixture (private-ed25519.pem) for KeyManagement tests; content-identified. Shor-vulnerable signing key material; test-only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed PKCS#8 X25519 private-key fixture (private-X25519.pem) for KeyManagement tests; content-identified. Shor-vulnerable key-agreement key material; test-only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-384 and P-521 curve support inside the library's ECDH-ES/ECDSA algorithms: benchmark JWKs ('crv'=>'P-384'/'P-521'), ECKey registries, tests. Shor-vulnerable NIST curves for both key agreement and ES384/ES512 signatures; migration targets ML-KEM-768 / ML-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed448 signature support: capability-checked DI registration (Ed448::isSupported(), signature_eddsa.php alias), OKP key generation command (Ed25519/Ed448/X25519/X448 curves). Shor-vulnerable EdDSA signature curve; migration target ML-DSA-87-class / SLH-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X448 key-agreement support: OKP key construction (X448PrivateKey::create / X448PublicKey::create), curve validation, console key-generation commands, ECDH-ES use. Shor-vulnerable DH agreement; migration target ML-KEM-1024-class.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed PKCS#8 X448 private-key fixture (private-X448.pem) for KeyManagement tests; content-identified. Shor-vulnerable key-agreement key material; test-only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed PKCS#8 Ed448 private-key fixture (private-ed448.pem) for KeyManagement tests; content-identified. Shor-vulnerable signing key material; test-only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's post-quantum ML-DSA (FIPS 204) signature algorithms ML-DSA-44/65/87: capability-probed DI registration (MLDSA44::isSupported()), signature_mldsa.php service aliases, the MLDSA signature class, key analyzer, console generation, and RFC 9964 vector fixtures. This is the PQ migration target for the library's RSA/ECDSA/EdDSA signatures; availability depends on the runtime OpenSSL build (probed at runtime by AKPKey).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The shipped AES-GCM surface: A128GCM/A192GCM/A256GCM content encryption (aes-*-gcm via OpenSSL) plus AESGCMKW (A128GCMKW/A192GCMKW/A256GCMKW key wrapping), registered through encryption_aesgcm.php / encryption_aesgcmkw.php DI. PQ-acceptable AEAD at 128/192/256-bit key sizes.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Experimental BLAKE2B JOSE MAC algorithm: Blake2b MacAlgorithm class (hash_equals-verified), 'BLAKE2B' DI alias, plus blake2b-256 thumbprint hashing in tests. PQ-acceptable hash/MAC (Grover-only); shipped experimental surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 key size across the content/key-encryption algorithms: A128CCM variants (aes-128-ccm), A128CTR, A128CBC-HS256 and A128GCM. 128-bit symmetric keys give a 64-bit Grover-margin post-quantum — acceptable now, first candidate to raise to 256-bit.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 as the ConcatKDF digest for ECDH-ES CEK derivation (ConcatKDF.php) and in test hashing. PQ-acceptable hash function; the surrounding ECDH agreement is the vulnerable part.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBES2-HS256/384/512+A128/192/256KW (RFC 7518 §4.7): password-to-CEK derivation via hash_pbkdf2 with a DEFAULT ITERATION COUNT OF 4096 (constructor nb_count), a caller-settable cap of 1,000,000 (DEFAULT_MAX_COUNT), and a 64-byte random salt per wrap. The decrypt side takes p2c from the token header and enforces the max. 4096 PBKDF2 iterations is far below OWASP's 600k guidance for PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 — weak password KDF defaults in shipped library code, and the single most important PBES2 posture

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ConcatKDF (RFC 7518 §4.6, X9.63-style) derives content-encryption keys from ECDH shared secrets inside the ECDH-ES key-agreement algorithms (AbstractECDH → ConcatKDF::generate). PQ-safe KDF over a Shor-vulnerable agreement.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The RFC 9964 appendix A all-zero-seed ML-DSA-44 key: content-identified in AKPKey.php (PROBE_KEY, used to detect ML-DSA support in the OpenSSL build) and the openssl-cli vectors. Public test-vector material, not a live secret.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ML-DSA-65 example key from the RFC 9964 openssl-cli vectors; content-identified public test-vector key material.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The shipped ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD content-encryption algorithm: capability check against openssl_get_cipher_methods(), DI registration (encryption_experimental_chacha20_poly1305.php), AlgorithmCollector entry, benchmarks and tests. PQ-acceptable AEAD. The Poly1305 half is the same asset (ALG-e6238d01, linked same_as this object).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256 key size across A256CCM variants (aes-256-ccm), A256CTR, A256CBC-HS512 and A256GCM content encryption. 256-bit symmetric keys — full PQ margin under Grover.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ML-DSA-87 example key from the RFC 9964 openssl-cli vectors; content-identified public test-vector key material.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PKCS#12 (.p12/PFX) keystore loading: JWKFactory::fromPKCS12CertificateFile (openssl_pkcs12_read), the P12 JWKSource DI definition, and the P12CertificateLoader console command. Keystore decryption inherits whatever PBE scheme the p12 was produced with (often legacy PBES1/3DES or PBES2-SHA1); the loader itself is neutral. Real PKI-keystore surface shipped in the library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two committed PKCS#12 (PFX) keystore fixtures (CertRSA.p12) used by Console and KeyManagement P12 tests; content-identified. RSA-certificate keystores carrying private key material; test-only, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CSR generation (openssl req -new) for the RFC 9964 fixture certificate chain (ML-DSA-44 test leaf). Test-fixture infrastructure only, not production PKI; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed PKCS#8 encrypted private-key fixture (pkcs8.private.encrypted.key) for KeyManagement tests; content-identified. Encrypted RSA key material, test-only.
